title: A place for your next chapter.
intro: One account for buying and selling. Your private information stays private.
name: Your name
passwordHint: Use a unique password of 12–128 characters.
privateIntro: Apply to sell your own watches. Official dealers and brands are onboarded separately by the platform.
privacyBody: Verification is not a public document. No buyer, unrelated seller or business can browse your proof.
demo: Course demonstration: use synthetic information only. Never upload a real identity document or payout account.
recoverySent: If the account is eligible, a recovery message is captured in the simulated mailbox. Ask the local mailbox operator for the link.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again; prior sessions have been revoked.
unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing has been confirmed. Try again.
error: The request could not be completed. Check your fields and try again.
invalid_credentials: Sign-in details were not accepted. Try again or recover your account.
weak_password: Choose a unique password of 12–128 characters.
registration_unavailable: Use sign-in or account recovery for this email.
try_later: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
invalid_reset: This recovery link is expired or has been used. Request a new one.
operation_conflict: This request key was already used for different information. Reload before continuing.
stale_application: This application has changed or is awaiting review. Reload the current case.
sellerSubtitle: A private review of your identity and watch possession. This does not authenticate a watch or grant business status.
proofHint: Use a text file starting DEMO:, at most 64 KiB. Do not include real documents.
noApplication: You have not submitted a private seller application.
saved: Saved by the service. You can return after restarting or changing language.
signInRequired: Sign in to access your own private records.
badEvidence: Choose synthetic text files starting DEMO:, each no larger than 64 KiB.
javascriptRequired: Private forms require JavaScript. An action is only confirmed after the service acknowledges it.
logoutFailed: You are signed out here, but server revocation could not be confirmed. Retry sign-out before leaving this device.
noEvidencePublic: Your proof is never part of a public watch listing.
listingProofBody: Every listing needs a fresh private watch photo with its single-use code within 24 hours. Seller approval is not watch authentication. Changed watch identity or relisting requires new proof.
issueHint: Request a code, then submit a private synthetic PNG photo showing the watch and code.
privatePhoto: Private synthetic watch photo (PNG, up to 1 MiB)
safePhoto: The photo excludes identity documents, full serials and former-owner details. This declaration does not detect sensitive pixels.
syntheticPhoto: This is a synthetic demonstration photo.
proof_issued: Code issued; private photo is still required.
proof_pending: Submitted; assigned independent review is required before publication.
proof_expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
proof_stale: Listing identity or revision changed. Request fresh proof.
stale_proof: Proof changed. Check the current proof before continuing.
invalid_proof: The code does not match this challenge. Check current proof.
bad_photo: Choose a valid synthetic PNG photo up to 1 MiB and confirm both declarations.
proof_approved: Listing possession proof approved. Publication still requires current permission and listing checks.
proof_correction: Correction requested. Read the review notes and request a fresh code.
proof_rejected: Listing proof rejected. Correct the evidence and request a fresh code.
proof_suspended: Listing proof suspended. Contact support before publication.
operation_pending: The password change is still unresolved. Retry the same request to check its result.
sampleIntro: Each button opens its own tab, already signed in: each sample tab as one made-up sample account, and the Operator tab as the site's own operator account. Every tab keeps its own sign-in, so signing out in one tab leaves the others signed in.
sampleOnly: The sample accounts and their data are made up. The Operator tab is the site's own operator account.
sampleKeyHeld: This link signs each tab in without a password while the demo switch is on.
sampleNoKey: This kit link holds no demo key, so it opens no tabs. Open the kit link you were given.
sampleTabNoKey: This tab was opened without the demo key, so it cannot sign in. Open it again from the kit link.
sampleNoSet: This page shows no tabs without a sample set. Open the kit link you were given; it names its set.
sampleSetDemo: These tabs hold the class demo accounts.
sampleSetClickTest: These tabs hold the rehearsal accounts, kept apart from the class demo.
sampleEnteringBody: This tab gets a sign-in of its own.
sampleSwitchOff: Sample entry is off right now, so this tab cannot sign in. Open it again from the kit link once entry is on.
sampleSignedOut: This sample tab is signed out. To sign it in again, open it from the kit link.
sampleReload: This tab could not sign in yet. Reload this tab to try again.
slot_unavailable: Sample tabs sign in only from their sample link. Use an ordinary tab to sign in with a password or to create an account.
demo_entry_refused: This sample link is not valid. Ask the presenter for the current kit link.
sample_account_unavailable: This sample account is not ready yet.
operator_link_unavailable: The operator link is not set up on this site.
invalid_session_slot: This tab lost its sample sign-in. Open it again from the sample tabs page.
